Interface CompaniesApi

public interface CompaniesApi
Entry point of the Companies API.

Companies registers its implementation with Bukkit's ServicesManager while it enables. A plugin that declares Companies as depend (or softdepend and checks that it is enabled) can obtain it in its own onEnable with get() or with getServicesManager().load(CompaniesApi.class).

Threading. Every method of the API returns a CompletableFuture that completes off the main thread. Do not block the main thread on it with join() or get(). Run Bukkit calls that need the main thread through the scheduler, for example with future.thenAcceptAsync(result -> ..., runnable -> Bukkit.getScheduler().runTask(plugin, runnable)).

Reads and writes. Reads work as soon as the API is registered. Write operations need the economy, which Companies sets up once the server has started; before that, and while Companies runs without an economy, they complete exceptionally with an ApiNotReadyException.

Anonymity. Companies keeps orders anonymous: players never learn who placed an order they work on, and owners never learn which company works on theirs. The API and its events expose both sides. Use them for logic, logging or staff tools, and never show the owner of an order to the members of a company or the company to the owner.

Multiple servers. All data lives in the shared database, so reads see the changes of every server. Events are fired only on the server where the action happened.
